<a id="fang_removal"></a>
## Gothic Stage Theme: `fang_removal.yml`

A gothic eight-bit stage theme in the manner of Castlevania's Vampire Killer, in D harmonic minor,
whose major fifth chord gives the style its pull: a square-wave lead, a second square two scale
steps below and a driving octave bass. The melody is its own.

<a id="incoming_message"></a>
## Ten Stages: `incoming_message.yml`

Nine minutes after Mega Man 2's intro and boss themes: ten stages, each in a key of its own set by
its scenes, changing theme exactly nine times with a one-bar fill between each, the last a reprise
of the first. Each stage's patterns are named after it, stage_0 to stage_9, and a chip track breaks
its chords into thirty-second notes as the old sound chips did.
